by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ s A B X hA hB hX hAB hs
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have hmA := left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A B
  have hmB := right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A B
  have hXA : X ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ hmA)
  have hXB : X ≠ B := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ hmB)
  have hn1 : ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, s.center, B} : Set P) := fun hcol =>
    hs.2.1 (hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hAB)
  have hn2 : ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, X, B} : Set P) := fun hcol =>
    hs.2.2 (hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hAB)
  have hcen := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.oangle_center_eq_two_zsmul_oangle hA hX hB hXA hXB
  have hsign : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle A s.center B).sign = (EuclideanGeometry.oangle A X B).sign :=
    (hs.oangle_sign_eq hmA hmB).symm
  have hy0 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_pos_of_not_collinear hn1
  have hy1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear hn1
  have hx0 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_pos_of_not_collinear hn2
  have hx1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear hn2
  set y := EuclideanGeometry.angle A s.center B with hy
  set x := EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B with hx
  have key : (y : Real.Angle) = (2 : ℤ) • (x : Real.Angle) → y = 2 * x := by
    intro h
    have h' : (y : Real.Angle) = ((2 * x : ℝ) : Real.Angle) := by
      rw [h, two_zsmul, ← Real.Angle.coe_add, two_mul]
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Real.Angle.angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub.mp h'
    have hpi := Real.pi_pos
    have k1 : (k : ℝ) < 1 := by nlinarith
    have k2 : (-1 : ℝ) < k := by nlinarith
    have k3 : k = 0 := by
      have : k < 1 := by exact_mod_cast k1
      have : -1 < k := by exact_mod_cast k2
      omega
    rw [k3] at hk
    simp at hk
    linarith
  apply key
  rcases hc : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle A X B).sign with _ | _ | _
  · exfalso
    exact hn2 (EuclideanGeometry.oangle_sign_eq_zero_iff_collinear.mp hc)
  · have ea := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_neg_angle_of_sign_eq_neg_one hc
    have eb := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_neg_angle_of_sign_eq_neg_one (hsign.trans hc)
    rw [ea, eb, smul_neg, neg_inj] at hcen
    exact hcen
  · have ea := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_angle_of_sign_eq_one hc
    have eb := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_angle_of_sign_eq_one (hsign.trans hc)
    rw [ea, eb] at hcen
    exact hcen
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B X : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → X ∈ s → A ≠ B → (line[ℝ, A, B]).SSameSide s.center X → EuclideanGeometry.angle A s.center B = 2 * EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B
